name: paper-engineering-assistant
description: Local-first desktop assistant for CS paper engineering with reviewer-aligned evidence workflows.

scripts.backend:dev:prisma:setup: pnpm env:dev:db-url:init && pnpm env:dev:compile && pnpm db:dev:migrate
scripts.db:dev:migrate: set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a; pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.env:dev:db-url:init: mkdir -p env/.secrets-store/dev && if [ ! -f env/.secrets-store/dev/database_url ]; then printf 'postgresql://%s@127.0.0.1:5432/postgres?schema=my_researcher_dev\n' "${USER:-postgres}" > env/.secrets-store/dev/database_url; fi && chmod 600 env/.secrets-store/dev/database_url
